QuestInfo.name: Triple Dummies
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9390355##k claimed to have been robbed by a party of three... Sounds like Triple Volt. He also mentioned a strange researcher with a magnifying glass...\r\nGo to #bSleepywood#k and head into the #bChilly Cave#k.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: #b#p9390354##k will lend you her magnifying glass. She is being unusually nice...\r\n

1.0: From my research, you appear to have something to tell me.
1.1: You look like you want something from me. What is it?

yes.0: My magnifying glass?! T-this is my treasure! My preci-- wait, no, I have about a thousand of them. Sure, you can have it.
yes.1: I can loan it to you whenever you want.

npc.0: Surely you know somebody with a magnifying glass... There's nothin' wrong with begging.
